checks.evidence: Candidate is intended to depict NASA Perseverance rover, not another rover family.
Six-wheel rover layout is required and must remain visible or logically present.
Mast/camera head must rise from the rover body.
Robotic arm must attach to the front/body area with an instrument turret at the end.
RIMFAX and MOXIE placement are common ambiguity risks and require explicit placement evidence before approval.
Forbidden substitutions are listed in policy and must be rejected if present.
The expected decision remains needs_review when instrument placement is ambiguous.

issues.message: MOXIE must be represented as an internal/body-mounted payload, not as an external antenna or decorative object.
RIMFAX must be associated with the lower/rear underside antenna region. Ambiguous placement must trigger needs_review.
